paper.title_en: Higher derivatives and ghosts through three centuries
paper.abstract_en: We outline the history of the research of dynamic systems including higher derivatives in the Lagrangian, The story starts in 1744 when Euler published a book where the Euler--Lagrange differential equations for a HD system were first written. The next important landmarks were the papers of Ostrogradsky (1850) and of Pais and Uhlenbeck (1950). Many articles written in the second half of the last century were influenced by a misconception that was widespread at the time --- it was believed that higher derivatives necessarily bring about a violation of unitarity. We understand today that this is not the case and there are many systems with benign ghosts where HD are present but unitarity is not violated. In this review, we present and discuss several examples of such (quantum) mechanical systems and 2D field theories. Then we will briefly discuss higher-derivative gravity theories in 4 dimensions. In that case, the question whether the ghosts there are benign or not has a special status due to the absence of a nonperturbative Hamiltonian and does not have a definite answer yet. However, if one restricts oneself to classical theory, one can argue that the ghosts {\it are} benign (benign classical ghostly system is a system that needs an infinite time to reach a singularity, and it seems to the case both in ordinary and in HD gravity: the cosmic censorship conjecture implies that the singularities are always surrounded by horizons, and it takes an infinite time on the clocks of a distant observer to reach a horizon). Finally, I discuss supersymmetric HD theories: conformal supergravity, where the ghosts are also probably benign, and then an interesting supersymmetric HD gauge theory in 6 dimensions. It involves a dimensionless coupling constant, is renormalizable and rather beautiful. Unfortunately, it is not unitary --- ghosts are not benign there.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该综述系统梳理了高阶导数拉格朗日系统的历史（从欧拉到 Ostrogradsky、Pais–Uhlenbeck），讨论良性鬼（benign ghost）与幺正性的关系，并延伸到四维高阶导数引力、共形超引力与六维超对称高阶导数规范理论。主题深度与对修改引力/引力理论基础的相关性较强，虽为综述、缺乏新计算，仍值得研究者点击深入阅读。
decision.title_zh: 跨越三个世纪的高阶导数与鬼
decision.abstract_zh: 我们概述了关于拉格朗日量中包含高阶导数的动力系统研究的历史。故事始于1744年，当时欧拉出版了一本书，其中首次写下了高阶导数系统的欧拉–拉格朗日微分方程。接下来的重要里程碑是 Ostrogradsky（1850年）和 Pais 与 Uhlenbeck（1950年）的论文。上世纪后半叶写成的许多文章受到了当时广为流传的一种误解的影响——人们认为高阶导数必然导致幺正性的破坏。我们今天明白情况并非如此，并且存在许多具有良性鬼的系统，其中存在高阶导数但幺正性并未被破坏。在本综述中，我们展示并讨论这类（量子）力学系统和二维场论的若干例子。然后我们将简要讨论4维中的高阶导数引力理论。在这种情况下，由于缺乏非微扰哈密顿量，那里的鬼是否为良性具有特殊地位，且尚无确定答案。然而，如果将自己限制在经典理论中，可以论证这些鬼是良性的（良性经典鬼系统是指需要无限时间才能到达奇点的系统，而普通引力和高阶导数引力中似乎都是这种情况：宇宙监督猜想意味着奇点总是被视界所包围，而远处的观察者时钟上需要无限时间才能到达视界）。最后，我讨论超对称高阶导数理论：共形超引力，其中鬼很可能也是良性的，然后是一个有趣的6维超对称高阶导数规范理论。它涉及一个无量纲耦合常数，是可重整化的且相当优美。不幸的是，它不是幺正的——那里的鬼不是良性的。
